take: Boston announced it has reinstated center Matthew Poitras from injured reserve. He returns to a third-line role after producing 4 goals and 3 assists in 8 games, though his own expected goals (a measure of shot quality) are 1.82, so he has scored about two goals more than his chances suggest. The Bruins have controlled 53 percent of five-on-five expected goals with 8-2-1 record. Tanner Jeannot, who plays 11:49 a night, was next in line for Poitras's minutes.
